snippet.title: The Pixel Boy's Adventures - iOS / Android Sokoban Game - Level 16 - Puzzle solution Pixel-boy.com
snippet.description:
The Pixel Boy's Adventures - Logical Puzzle Sokoban game for Apple iOS, Android

The Pixel Boy's Adventures is logical puzzle game with pixel art graphics, Sokoban puzzle game base clone. Goal is simple. Move the red box to the final stage. 

🌀 Puzzle adventure game
The Pixel Boy's Adventures is logical puzzle game. Pixel art, level editor, logical skils.to final stage.

🌀 Apple iOS, Android devices
The Pixel Boy's Adventures is available on iOS and Android official stores. Find it there and download!

🌀 60 levels and Level editor
If you feel that game is simple, you can make own levels for your friends. We can add them to game.

Website
https://www.pixel-boy.com/

Apple iOS download
https://apps.apple.com/cz/app/the-pixel-boys-adventures/id1498485765

Android download
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pixel_boy.game
